Samir —

Thanks for sending these over. Quick procurement checklist and follow-ups: 

- Certificate holder: please update the "Certificate Holder" to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 220 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- Additional insured: we usually require an additional insured endorsement on the commercial general liability (CG 20 10 or equivalent). If HymnCloud’s insurer can add Redwood as additional insured for ongoing services, that will clear the liability lane.
- Primary/Noncontributory: please confirm whether the endorsement is primary and noncontributory when added.
- W-9 received — thanks.
- Banking: we need an ACH/routing number file from billing for setting up invoicing in our AP system. If possible, send a CSV or a secure DocuSign with banking details (we redline for security).

Ben (CC) will manage PO creation once the endorsement is in place. Neha, can you confirm if we need any regional insurance language for CA-specific procurement?

Next steps: Samir sends updated endorsement + bank file, Ben issues PO, then invoicing can start under PO #{HC-4452-PO}. We typically need the endorsement before PO goes final; if underwriting requires time we can issue a conditional PO for initial ramp.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Avery
